info.name: Missing security headers
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: The response is missing one or more common security headers, making the endpoint more exposed to clickjacking, MIME sniffing and other client-side attacks.
info.remediation: Add Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy headers.

info.name: Grafana panel exposed
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: A Grafana instance was identified. Unauthenticated or weakly authenticated Grafana can disclose dashboards and datasource credentials.
info.remediation: Require authentication, restrict source networks and keep Grafana patched.

info.name: Apache Log4j RCE (Log4Shell)
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: The application may be vulnerable to Log4Shell, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Apache Log4j2 via JNDI lookups.
info.remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1 or later and remove JNDI lookup classes.

info.name: Deprecated TLS protocol supported
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: The server negotiates a deprecated TLS version, exposing connections to protocol-level downgrade attacks.
info.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1; leave TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only.
